comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Remediation pass complete for fixable npm audit items after user-applied npm audit fix:
- Added package.json overrides for handlebars/lodash/fast-xml-parser/minimatch/immutable/@smithy/config-resolver.
- Regenerated lockfile with npm install.
Results:
- Before this pass: 48 total (1 critical, 30 high).
- After this pass: 29 total (0 critical, 10 high).
Remaining highs are bundled dependencies inside @aws-amplify/data-construct and @aws-amplify/graphql-api-construct; npm cannot auto-fix or override bundled packages.
 confirms unresolved highs require major/breaking change path (including @aws-amplify/backend downgrade suggestion) or upstream patched releases from Amplify packages.
